title: BRAN compared with foundation models given one or both modalities
legend:
**Fig. 3 | BRAN compared with foundation models given one or both modalities.** Detection of 26 conditions from the AI-READI medical history, six possibly defined from encoder inputs, in 1,928 development participants.
**a**, Macro AUROC and BRAN minus each foundation model given one modality plus age (development, secondary analysis). Diamonds, official-test eye-alone contrasts.
**b**, Macro AUROC as each foundation model gains the other modality.
**c**, As in **a** for foundation models given both modalities, raw clinical values plus age and PCA-64 readouts. Ticks, one-sided Bonferroni bounds over five prespecified comparators. Lower block, the single scoring of a previously accessed official test (n ≥ 340, 24 conditions). Bottom, condition-group macro AUROC.
**d**, Per-condition wins, ties and losses against eight foundation-model arms (unadjusted paired 95% intervals).
Points, estimates. Bars, 95% participant bootstrap intervals (1,000 development and 2,000 official-test draws). †, tuned probe on the frozen BRAN state. ‡, BRAN's own condition heads. Adverse results. Every retinal foundation model beat BRAN's eye-only route in development, and VisionFM did so in the official test (**a**). Tuned BRAN combined tied its clinical-only route (**b**) and RETFound-Green, DINOv3, Labrador and raw clinical values plus age (**c**), and PCA-64 readouts tied the native heads. After Holm adjustment the native heads led raw clinical values plus age only in eye conditions, where RETFound-Green and DINOv3 with clinical data beat them, and trailed BRAN's clinical probe in cardiometabolic and vascular conditions (**c**). Official-test bounds cleared zero only for VisionFM (unadjusted one-sided P = 0.0005, others 0.036 to 0.4203, Bonferroni threshold 0.01), so **c** did not replicate, as prespecified power of 0.15 or less anticipated. Per-arm tuning removed the fixed C = 1 lead over three arms given both modalities (Extended Data Fig. 3c). Glaucoma and cataracts gave 9 of the 16 losses (**d**). VisionFM often chose the grid-edge C, so its estimates may be low. The **a** and **b** contrasts and **c** groups were specified after earlier results. RETFound-Green is not the original RETFound, and a Labrador cache discrepancy is unresolved. Only BRAN saw the 26 labels, and a label-free BRAN comparison is PLACEHOLDER.
methods_notes:
Readouts. Every foundation-model arm and every tuned BRAN state is read out by a StandardScaler and L2 logistic probe on frozen features, with C chosen per arm, condition and outer fold by inner five-fold log loss over 13 values from 0.0001 to 100. BRAN's native heads are the screening heads trained with the encoder in each outer fold, applied without refit to the same people, folds and bootstrap draws. AUROC is the unweighted macro average over conditions, and positive differences favour BRAN. Bars are 95% within-fold participant bootstrap intervals conditional on the fitted models (1,000 shared draws, at least 900 valid).
a. The native heads (0.7026 [0.6926, 0.7120]) and BRAN combined (0.6954 [0.6861, 0.7052]) exceeded all four arms by +0.0393 to +0.0631 and +0.0320 to +0.0559, with supplementary bounds, not prespecified, of +0.0276 to +0.0511 over 11 native comparisons and +0.0185 to +0.0428 over 24 tuned arms. BRAN combined minus the native heads was −0.0072 [−0.0111, −0.0034]. BRAN's eye-only route (0.6232 [0.6125, 0.6333]) scored below all three retinal foundation models with age (−0.0212 to −0.0164, one-sided Bonferroni bounds −0.0306 to −0.0245 in an eye-alone family of three prespecified in the native-heads protocol but not in F1). In the official test the same contrast was RETFound-Green −0.0157 [−0.0327, −0.0002] (one-sided P for BRAN better 0.9765), VisionFM −0.0239 [−0.0389, −0.0090] (one-sided P for BRAN better 0.9995) and DINOv3 −0.0109 [−0.0266, +0.0037] (one-sided P for BRAN better 0.9245), with two-sided Bonferroni intervals over three excluding zero only for VisionFM. The native retinal-route head trailed with paired intervals below zero against RETFound-Green and VisionFM. The native combined route exceeded the native clinical route (+0.0158 [+0.0105, +0.0211]), but that route reuses a head trained on both modalities, and with a probe fitted to each route the two tied.
b. Every foundation-model line rose by +0.0236 to +0.0518 with a paired interval above zero. BRAN combined minus its eye-only route was +0.0722 [+0.0652, +0.0797] and minus its clinical-only route −0.0007 [−0.0077, +0.0065]. Concatenation brought RETFound-Green and DINOv3 within 0.0004 of raw clinical values plus age (0.6914). Labrador's rise came mostly from the raw clinical values, which alone scored 0.0280 above Labrador with age, and adding the 384 BRAN eye features to them gave 0.6900. VisionFM features lowered AUROC below raw clinical values plus age (−0.0233 [−0.0329, −0.0138]). VisionFM with age, VisionFM with clinical data and Labrador with age chose the grid-edge penalty in 86, 57 and 21 of 130 condition-fold cells, so their estimates may be conservative.
c. The native heads' prespecified bounds were +0.0002 to +0.0250, and the smallest, against Labrador, fell to −0.0006 over all 11 native comparisons. BRAN combined tied RETFound-Green, DINOv3 and Labrador (bounds −0.0086 to −0.0042), exceeded VisionFM (+0.0274 [+0.0185, +0.0356]) and tied raw clinical values plus age (+0.0040 [−0.0039, +0.0116], bound −0.0050). The PCA-64 readouts (0.6962 to 0.6972) tied BRAN combined with higher point estimates and tied the native heads (+0.0054 to +0.0064). The native heads beat a probe refit on the same BRAN state by +0.0072. Under the fixed C = 1 readout BRAN combined exceeded all four concatenated arms (bounds +0.0236 to +0.0483), and per-arm tuning took three of those bounds below zero (Extended Data Fig. 3c and Extended Data Fig. 4b). Official test. It is a previously accessed paired check, not an untouched test, because the predecessor run of 26 August 2026 decoded these participants' nine blood counts and the source fields of ten conditions as inputs. The native heads scored 0.7132 [0.6932, 0.7333] on 24 admitted conditions. Native heads minus each comparator was raw clinical + age +0.0131 [−0.0009, +0.0277], bound −0.0031, P 0.039, RETFound-Green + clinical + age +0.0081 [−0.0040, +0.0192], bound −0.0068, P 0.088, DINOv3 + clinical + age +0.0112 [−0.0005, +0.0222], bound −0.0027, P 0.036, VisionFM + clinical + age +0.0294 [+0.0144, +0.0443], bound +0.0114, P 0.0005 and Labrador + clinical + BRAN eye features + age +0.0012 [−0.0103, +0.0124], bound −0.0125, P 0.4203. Every point estimate kept the development sign. Power fixed before scoring was 0.07 to 0.14, 0.07 to 0.13, 0.07 to 0.15, 0.48 to 0.85 and 0.05 to 0.09 in the same order, pessimistic to optimistic. Descriptive contrasts gave PCA-64 ties (−0.0023 to +0.0030) and native heads minus the tuned BRAN combined probe +0.0069 [+0.0020, +0.0121]. The verifier found no path from the BRAN code to the official split, and the adapted retinal tower embedded official-test photographs at inference only. Condition groups. Macro AUROC within the condition groups of Fig. 2 with marginal 95% intervals. Below each group are named the best foundation model with its own modality and with both, the latter including the PCA-64 readouts, chosen after seeing the results. In cardiometabolic and vascular conditions BRAN's clinical route scored above BRAN combined (0.7412 against 0.7236). In eye conditions the three retinal foundation models given only the eye and age (0.7167 to 0.7195) scored above BRAN combined (0.7026), and the native heads (0.7065) trailed RETFound-Green (−0.0170 [−0.0333, −0.0017]) and DINOv3 (−0.0194 [−0.0351, −0.0036]) given clinical data. Against raw clinical values plus age the native lead held after Holm adjustment over 12 group tests only in eye conditions (+0.0327 [+0.0123, +0.0522]). In cardiometabolic and vascular conditions the native heads tied raw clinical values plus age (+0.0029 [−0.0061, +0.0118]) and fell below BRAN's tuned clinical-route probe (−0.0110 [−0.0184, −0.0037], Extended Data Fig. 3a).
d. Glaucoma was a loss against all 6 retinal arms and cataracts against 3, so these two eye conditions hold 9 of the 16 losses, and 4 of the other 7 were against Labrador with clinical data and BRAN eye features. These intervals are exploratory and unadjusted, and about 10 of 208 null contrasts would exclude zero by chance.
All panels. All development results reuse AI-READI development data. Only the downstream readout and the information budget are matched, not upstream supervision, pretraining data, feature dimension or compute. The BRAN encoder and native heads saw the 26 condition labels and the foundation models did not, so any BRAN advantage mixes representation quality with label exposure. A comparison with a BRAN state that never saw those labels is PLACEHOLDER. The native contrasts outside the five prespecified comparators, the modality contrasts of b and the group results of c come from an amendment written after the tuned benchmark and the earlier native-head record were known, so they are a labelled secondary analysis. RETFound-Green is not the original RETFound model, and the Labrador cache has an unresolved replay discrepancy of up to 0.0054 AUROC per condition. †, a tuned probe on the frozen BRAN state. ‡, BRAN's native condition heads. No participant-level points are shown.
Conditions that may be defined from encoder inputs. Six of the 26 conditions (elevated A1C, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, obesity, prediabetes and type II diabetes) may be defined from measurements that BRAN also receives as inputs, a list that awaits registry confirmation. Without them, the 20-condition development macro gave the same verdicts for both BRAN references, with BRAN combined bounds above zero only against VisionFM (+0.0051, others −0.0092 to −0.0052) and native-head bounds above zero against all five comparators (+0.0013 to +0.0160). In the official test the 18 admitted conditions outside the six gave a native macro AUROC of 0.6944, and only the native-head bound against raw clinical values plus age cleared zero (+0.0016, VisionFM −0.0063), a secondary result.
